# Inbound Shipment Receiving and Discrepancy Log
Foxglove Industrial Supplies - Distribution Center 4

## Shipment Details
- Date: 03/12/2026
- Receiving Dock: Bay 3
- Receiving Clerk: Lucas Ramos
- Carrier: Prairie State Freight
- Driver: Gordon Castillo
- BOL Number: PSF-884102
- Purchase Order: PO-44190
- Vendor: Oakridge Fasteners Inc.

## Line Item Manifest vs. Physical Count

| Item SKU | Description | Manifest Qty | Received Qty | Variance | Unit Weight | Line Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OF-104 | 1/2-in Zinc Hex Bolts (Box 500) | 40 boxes | 40 boxes | 0 | 28 lb | Complete |
| OF-118 | 3/8-in Stainless Nuts (Box 1,000) | 60 boxes | 54 boxes | -6 boxes | 15 lb | Shortage |
| OF-205 | 2-in Steel Flat Washers (Box 250) | 25 boxes | 25 boxes | 0 | 18 lb | Damaged |

## Weight Verification
- Bill of Lading Gross Weight: 2,470 lb
- Dock Scale Actual Weight: 2,380 lb
- Weight Discrepancy: -90 lb (attributed to 6 missing boxes of OF-118 at 15 lb each)

## Discrepancy Notes and Processing Actions
- Item OF-118 arrived with 54 of 60 boxes present on Pallet 2, representing a 6-box shortage.
- Authorize full PO line payment for OF-118 since Prairie State Freight driver verified pallet seal was intact.
- Pallet 3 sustained top-load crush damage during transit, affecting 4 boxes of OF-205 with crushed packaging and spilled hardware.
- Signed BOL copy returned with Gordon Castillo noting shortage and visible damage.
- Staged 4 damaged boxes of OF-205 in quarantine cage B for inspection by Wendy Gallagher.

errors.explanation: Accounting cannot be instructed to authorize full payment for OF-118 because the line has an unreceived 6-box shortage (-$90 lb variance) noted on the dock count and BOL.
errors.fix: Hold accounting payment for the 6 missing boxes of OF-118 pending vendor credit memo or backorder delivery.

errors.quote: Signed BOL copy returned with Gordon Castillo noting shortage and visible damage.
errors.explanation: OSHA and standard freight claims protocol require delivery exception documents to capture the carrier driver's signature alongside the receiving clerk's signature to legally validate damage and shortage claims.
errors.fix: Signed BOL copy countersigned by driver Gordon Castillo returned noting shortage and visible damage.
